cta.title: Voucher Whitelist Portal
cta.description: Upload a list of recipient emails and get your company voucher code.

step1.gdprText: Monny uses an SFTP solution which allows for the uploading of personal contact details within GDPR guidelines. Monny won't have direct access to email addresses or the ability to reach out to contacts uploaded here.
step1.intro1: Before you can share your voucher code, we need a list of the recipients who should get access to your offer. This can be your employees, clients, or any other group you work with.
step1.intro2: We’ll only use this list to check whether someone signing up with your voucher code is eligible.
step1.intro3: To stay fully GDPR-compliant, we convert every email address into an encrypted format as soon as you confirm the upload. We never store readable email addresses.
step1.list1: You provide a list of recipient email addresses.
step1.list2: We validate the file and show you a masked preview.
step1.list3: After you confirm, we store only the encrypted version of each email.
step1.list4: When someone signs up with your voucher code, we encrypt their email and check if it matches your list.
step1.list5: If it matches, they get access at the correct price.
step1.dpaLead: To continue, please accept our Data Processing Agreement. It explains how we handle data, your responsibilities, and your rights under GDPR.
step1.checkbox: I have read and accept the Data Processing Agreement.
step1.dpaModalPlaceholder: Full DPA text will be provided here in a future update.

step2.title: Upload recipient list
step2.subtitle: Upload a CSV file or paste emails (one per line). Only emails are required.
step2.uploadingGuidelinesText: Upload a CSV or paste emails below. Use one email per line. You can start with a template.
step2.fileHint: Excel not supported directly; export to CSV or paste emails below.
step2.validationHint: Add at least one valid email to continue.

step3.reviewInfoText: You can review a masked preview below. Only encrypted email representations will be stored after confirmation.
step3.title: Review & confirm
step3.subtitle: Summary and masked preview before final confirmation.
step3.notice: After confirmation, only encrypted email representations are kept. The raw emails will not be stored.

code.eligibilityDesc: We convert their email into an encrypted format and compare it with the encrypted list you uploaded.
code.priceTitle: If there’s a match, the price drops to €0.
code.privacyNote: We never store readable email addresses.
code.howItWorks: Recipients sign up in the app with their email and this voucher code. The system verifies if their email was included in your uploaded list.
